title: The best Condon band
summary: The longest-lasting group had Ed Hall, Cutty Cutshall, Schroeder and Cliff Leeman; he judges it best with Peanuts Hucko.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: But, this was kind of the way it was though for over a lot of the time with Condon--- - wasn't it -- the guys would come in and play and then leave and some---
Well, there was a few changes - there was always a change coming up here and there.
Weren't you considered "the" really basic band? The longest time band--

Well, I think the longest time band was probably Edmond Hall and Cutty Cutshall, and Schroeder and Cliff Leeman and we had drums changed all the time. The changes would be between George Wettling and Cliff Leeman and we had several bass players - changes of bass players in there. And, I think Peanuts and Pee Wee Russell - we had those clarinets - changing from time to time. But, I think the best and the most exciting band, of course, was the band-- when we had Cutty Cutshall and---
Ed Hall, but also, Peanuts Hucko-- the band was its best at those times.
Yeah and that was really a swinging band.
